text:
nora: quick check-in on deimos13b-int6 bring-up. product asked for a crisp econ + quality scorecard (1 para) + single-line GTN recommendation by EOD.

felix: TL;DR: int6 buys ~28% token savings vs fp16 baseline but we see measurable drop in code generation correctness (unit tests) and structured JSON output stability on API patterns. full notes below.

anika: perf/econ snapshot (cold-kv): p50 ~140ms, p95 ~260ms on our A100 crop; warmed-kv expected to raise KV hit from 22% -> ~50% for typical webapp prefixes. rough unit econ:
```
cost_per_token: $0.00082
avg_tokens_per_req: 340
unit_cost_per_request: ~$0.28
delta_vs_fp16: -28% token spend
```

felix: quality: codegen pass@1 on our CI suite drops from 72% -> 61% (major failures in edge case asserts). structured-output schema failures + missing fields up ~6%. conversational chat and short answers unaffected.

nora: product wants simple traffic flag: green/amber/red and a 1-line rationale.

anika: amber  enable for non-code routes (chat, summarization where schema not strict). Block codegen, schema-heavy API responses, and high-risk extraction pipelines until we validate rescoring/verifier fixes.

felix: proposed mitigations: 1) fp16 verifier: run cheap fp16/float32 rescore for codegen candidates and prefer verified sample (adds ~+9% cost) 2) schema-aware constrained decoding + token-level lexicon biasing 3) prompt-anchoring (priming templates) for structured outputs.

nora: ops ask: schedule two canaries: A) 4% chat traffic w/ warm-kv, B) 0% codegen routes + a small verification A/B where 10% of codegen requests are given fp16-rescore. capture unit-test failures and JSON-schema errors.

bench-bot: canary created: deimos13b-int6 -> 2026-09-21T10:00Z; A: 4% chat routes (warm-kv=true), B: 10% codegen-rescore (fp16 verifier), region: us-west-2. :white_check_mark:

felix: GTN blurb suggestion (one para): "Deimos13b-int6 delivers ~28% token-cost savings vs our fp16 baseline with modest latency improvements when warmed; however, we observed regressions in code generation correctness and structured-output schema stability. Recommend gated rollout: enable for interactive text & summarization, but route production codegen and schema-critical endpoints through an fp16 verification path or hold until constrained decoding and priming mitigations are validated."

anika: one-line rec: amber  gated rollout for non-code routes; require fp16 verification or hold for codegen/schema endpoints.

nora: good. felix/anika, please attach the top-5 failing unit tests and 6 schema error examples to the canary ticket. i'll brief GTN with this capsule. :thumbsup:
